title: Verify Document Preview Viewport and Per-File Rotation controls
description: Inspect #col-preview viewport. Click rotate 90 clockwise button in preview controls and verify preview controls remain active.
category: Phase 5: High-DPI Canvas Preview, Rotation & Safety Isolation

Verify preview toolbar controls respond cleanly

title: Verify Settings modal tabs and live search filtering

category: Phase 5: High-DPI Canvas Preview, Rotation & Safety Isolation

steps.description: Click #tabBtnShortcuts to switch to Shortcuts & Rename Rules tab
Verify #inputSearchShortcuts is visible for live search filtering

title: Verify Add Document modal layering and Smart Keyword Generator
description: In Settings modal, click #btnAddDocToPreset to open #modalAddDocument at z-9999. Verify Smart Keyword Generator #btnAutoGenerateKeywords and Save button.
category: Phase 5: High-DPI Canvas Preview, Rotation & Safety Isolation

steps.description: Verify #modalAddDocument is visible in front of Settings modal
